    Every line

    Click a header to sort, or a row to see that line's stops. "Longest trip" is the line's longest regular branch.

    Source: the MTA's published subway schedule (GTFS), timetable in effect — to —. Miles are measured along the MTA's track shapes. Express variants (6 and 7 diamond, F express) count with their lines. Stations are counted per platform group, so a big complex like Times Sq counts more than once; transfer complexes group them. The Staten Island Railway is included for comparison. Map: city shorelines from NYC City Planning's borough boundaries, nearby New Jersey and Long Island land from Census zip code areas (approximate), and streets traced from the MTA's bus routes, so only main streets appear.
